text:
lee: Kicking off preflight for enabling mosaic13b-v2 in the model catalog. Change window 2026-04-01 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need ✅ from infra, telemetry, and product.

mohit: quick check — eval suite passed on quality samples, perf looks ~5% slower p95 than current default but within SLA for most routes. Will post latency histogram in a sec.

ashley: +1 on quality. Can we set a conservative fallback ordering and pin enterprise customers to mosaic13b-v1 for 48h?

lee: yes on pin for enterprise customers. Suggest auto-unpin after 48h unless a manual hold.

deploybot: Preflight checklist started:
- are we in change window? yes
- coverage: canary traffic config present
- observability hooks attached
- rollback policy defined

opsbot: infra capacity check: slot pool has 12% spare headroom in us-west-2 during the selected hour. autoscale buffer set to +20% for the cutover.

ashley: proposed fallback ordering (for catalog entry mosaic13b):
```
fallback_order: [mosaic13b-v2-quant, mosaic13b-v2-8bit, mosaic13b-v1, mosaic-lite]
pin_overrides: {"enterprise/*": "mosaic13b-v1"}
rollout: {canary: 1%, ramp: 6h, full: 24h}
rollback_triggers: [p95_latency +30%, error_rate +1.5x, quality_regression_failures >3]
```

mohit: small ask — add a manual hold flag for EU region in case of sudden latency spikes due to tokenization differences.

ashley: updated: added eu_hold: true default and will set to false during the canary window if metrics stable.

lee: agreeing on rollback triggers. For actions: if any trigger hits during canary, deploybot should immediately shift canary to fallback_order[0] and set pin for 1h while SRE triages.

deploybot: Ack. I will run the canary at 2026-04-01T02:10:00Z and monitor the configured triggers. Auto-fallback will be executed immediately on trigger.

mohit: also adding a light-weight eval set that runs on 100 canary requests for hallucination and instruction-following; results will be posted to the rollout dashboard.

lee: release note blurb request from growth: "mosaic13b-v2 now available with lower memory footprint; opt-in canary starting 2026-04-01."

sarah: I'll draft the release note and include the enterprise pin & rollback details. Also adding step for support to alert product-safety if quality_regression_failures > 0 during canary.

ashley: final checklist before go:
- [x] fallback ordering configured
- [x] enterprise pin set for 48h by default
- [x] rollback triggers defined
- [x] infra headroom + autoscale confirmed
- [x] telemetry evaluations enabled

lee: green from me. Mohit, Sarah, Ashley pls post an explicit approve when you're ready and deploybot will proceed at the scheduled time.

mohit: approve

sarah: approve

ashley: approve — leaving eu_hold enabled until we validate canary metrics for 30m.

deploybot: Scheduled: mosaic13b-v2 canary starting 2026-04-01T02:10:00Z. Will post canary heartbeat messages here and the dashboard links. If any rollback trigger fires, I will pin to fallback and notify @sre-team. :rocket:
